components.name: parametric_marginals
components.source_to_target_assumptions: A0 same-population reconstruction. Weight uses lognormal marginals; baseline parameters solve truncated-lognormal moment equations for weight <=180 kg. Later weight is positive without that cap. PFS is beta on [1,5], AUC outcomes beta on [0,1], and errors negative binomial conditioned on <=512. Beta and untruncated count parameters match supplied moments at population level; the distant count truncation may make a negligible moment change. Shapes, absence of endpoint atoms and continuous PFS are assumptions, not source facts.

components.name: dependence_sensitivity_set
components.source_to_target_assumptions: No covariance is supplied. target preserves the parent: weight latent repeat correlation 0.90, behavioral repeat correlation 0.60, stable cross-discounting correlation 0.30, other cross-domain covariances zero. stable_trait introduces a stable common factor of variance 0.25 with signs +weight,+PFS,+errors,-AUC100,-AUC1000. Endpoint-specific stable fractions are 0.65 for weight, 0.35 for PFS/errors and 0.20 for each AUC, plus a 0.15 stable shared discounting factor. Residual fractions are 0.10 for weight and 0.40 for behaviors. occasion_state moves only the 0.25 common variance into independent person-visit states; same-visit latent covariance is unchanged from stable_trait, but repeat correlations become 0.65 for weight and 0.35 for behaviors. Its cross-domain covariance across visits is zero except 0.15 shared discounting covariance. All sums are one by construction; factor constructions ensure positive semidefiniteness. These numerical choices and signs are qualitative sensitivity assumptions, not estimates. Transformed Pearson correlations need not equal latent values.

components.name: exact_count_attendance
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Independent Gaussian attendance factors have variance fractions 0.60 person, 0.30 person-visit and 0.10 endpoint-visit. Ranking them separately for each supplied denominator yields exact observed counts, shared visit nonresponse and persistent but potentially intermittent missingness. Attendance factors are independent of outcome factors, a conditional-count MCAR assumption. Individual masks, missingness causes and informative attrition remain unknown.

components.name: sampling_and_interface
components.source_to_target_assumptions: n counts persons, each with exactly five rows; counts round(n_observed*n/75). New ordinal synthetic keys have no source linkage. A local default_rng(seed) supplies all randomness. Input evidence is read-only; there is no generator filesystem or network access. Marginal sample moments fluctuate across cohorts and are not forcibly matched. Scenario IDs dispatch explicitly; attendance draws/masks are identical across the three scenarios at the same seed and the default target remains the exact parent generator behavior.

changes_from_parent: Preserve every marginal family, supplied moment input, exact denominator, measurement support, enrollment weight cap and attendance mechanism. Retain target unchanged. Add stable_trait and occasion_state to expose unresolved cross-domain and temporal dependence. No corrections were inferred from target findings. Parent feedback was source-only and valid; its five out-of-envelope variable/seed records were not used to tune parameters or select seeds. Final allocation is 7/7/6 = 20 total cohorts, not 20 per scenario and not posterior probabilities.

source_check_results.interpretation: All nine scheduled source cohorts passed exact support/count/schema, evidence immutability and global-RNG checks. 215 of 225 marginal diagnostic envelopes passed; the ten named deviations are retained without parameter tuning or seed selection. These are supplied-input reconstruction diagnostics, not validation of dependence or findings. No reserved analyses, reference rows or evaluator outputs used. Controller will attach its source feedback.

failures.resolution: Persisted the compact per-cohort summaries already printed in the failed tool output using native Python scalar values. Generator unchanged; no cohort rerun or extra seed generated.

calibration_log.options_reviewed: Exactly three numerical structures: parent independence anchor, stable signed cross-domain coupling, and occasion-specific signed coupling. Neither extra candidates nor alternative seeds were simulated. Opposite sign structures, informative attrition and non-Gaussian copulas remain unresolved outside this deliberately limited set; the retained set does not cover every compatible model.
calibration_log.noncohort_calculations: Retained analytic beta/negative-binomial moment formulas and deterministic baseline truncated-lognormal parameter solve. Variance fractions sum to one by construction; no empirical joint matrix or reserved analysis computed.
calibration_log.read_notes: Initial bundled allowlisted reads produced truncated tool output. Template, parent generator and parent decision were reread; source-check tail and compact parent-feedback summary were read. No non-allowlisted source was inspected.
